comment: Pinned identities of the stock Xiaomi Fastboot ROM images that the dual
layout writes to the Android slot.  These are checksums of a published
vendor package, not secrets: they exist so that the installer refuses a
ROM directory that is not the exact release this port was validated
against.  The ROM itself is an upstream input and is not redistributed
here.  'partition' is always the _a slot name (or the non-slotted super);
the installer never writes _b apart from boot_b with the project image.
'sparse' marks an Android sparse image, whose bytes cannot be compared
against the partition content, so it is always flashed when requested.
